title: Option models, SMDP planning, and intra-option learning on four rooms
brief: Solve option models as linear systems and check them against rollouts, plan over primitives and hallway options with SMDP value iteration, and write the SMDP and intra-option Q-learning updates.
hints: discounted_return is the sum of gamma ** np.arange(len(rewards)) * rewards. Dropping the powers sums the rewards undiscounted.
option_model solves (I - gamma * P_pi * (1 - beta)[None, :]) X = Y twice: once with Y = r_pi for R_o, and once with Y = gamma * P_pi * beta[None, :] for P_o. P_pi = env.P[np.arange(S), option.pi].

In smdp_value_iteration, build q[i] = np.where(option.init, R_o + P_o @ V, -np.inf) for every option, take q.max(axis=0), and reset V[env.goal] to 0 after each sweep. P_o already holds gamma^k, so add no extra gamma.
smdp_q_update bootstraps with gamma ** k * max over avail[s2] of Q[s2], and with 0 when terminated.

intra_option_q_update loops over the options with options[i].init[s] and options[i].pi[s] == a. Its target is r + gamma * ((1 - beta[s2]) * Q[s2, i] + beta[s2] * best), where best is the max of Q[s2] over options that can start in s2.
interrupted_beta is np.where(best > Q[:, o], 1.0, options[o].beta), where best is the max of Q over the options that can start in each state.
